name: omarchy-remote
description: Touch shell for an Omarchy desktop: terminal, files, browser tabs, Herdr agents, and host TUIs from a phone, tablet, or browser window.

scripts.lint: npm run format:check && cargo fmt --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.test: npm run format:check && node --test scripts/worker.test.mjs scripts/keyboard.test.mjs scripts/remote-client.test.mjs scripts/source-watch.test.mjs scripts/build-downloads.test.mjs desktop/test/hosts.test.mjs
